## type-define
define
entity person;
## type-undefine
undefine
person;
## sub-define
define
employee sub person;
## sub-undefine
undefine
sub person from employee;
## value-define
define
name value string;
## value-redefine
redefine
name value integer;
## value-undefine
undefine
value string from name;
## owns-define
define
person owns name;
## owns-undefine
undefine
owns name from person;
## relates-define
define
friendship relates friend;
## relates-undefine
undefine
relates friend from friendship;
## specialization-define
define
child-relation relates child-role as parent-role-a;
## specialization-redefine
redefine
child-relation relates child-role as parent-role-b;
## specialization-undefine
undefine
as parent-role-b from child-relation relates child-role;
## plays-define
define
person plays friendship:friend;
## plays-undefine
undefine
plays friendship:friend from person;
## doc-define
define
entity person @doc("line\n\"quoted\"");
## doc-redefine
redefine
person @doc("changed");
## doc-undefine
undefine
@doc from person;
## regex-redefine
redefine
name value string @regex("^b+$");
## card-redefine
redefine
person owns name @card(0..2);
## range-define
define
name value string @range(1..10);
## values-define
define
name value integer @values(1, 2);
## sub-meta-fallback
undefine
@meta("owner") from employee sub person;
-- atomic-next --
define
employee sub person @meta("owner", "new");
## meta-keyed-undefine
undefine
@meta("owner") from employee sub person;
## function-define-with-metadata
define
fun answer($seed: integer) -> integer @doc("answer docs") @meta("owner", "core"):
match
  let $value = $seed;
return first $value;
## function-redefine
redefine
fun answer($seed: integer) -> integer:
match
  let $value = 2;
return first $value;
## function-undefine
undefine
fun answer;
